Axiom:
When reopening a task ticket, append to Execution Log:
``` ### Round N — , fix:
| Phase | Kind | Status | Target Files | Deps | |-------|-------|--------|-------------|------| | P | fix | [ ] | | — | | P | test | [ ] | | P | ```
Allocate concrete next-unused PhaseIDs in the ticket; placeholders are not valid written output. Every task-owned code finding, including a one-line bug, appends a new Round with at least one concrete `fix` PhaseID and one dependent concrete `test` PhaseID. Multiple findings sharing one owner may share that Round, but none may bypass it.
Set ticket Meta Status → `[ ] TODO`. Update `Reopens: `. Sync tracker: the owning `*.3-tasks.md` row → `[ ] TODO`; parent rollups (scope and `specs/3-tasks.md`) → adjust counts.
